description: Cultuurhistorische Kaart (CHK2) - Spoorwegen is a dataset listed in National Georegister of the Netherlands, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geoportaal.fryslan.nl. Resistant with disappeared and existing railways in Fryslân. Coverage: NL. The portal shows the English title as "Cultural History Map (CHK2) - Railways" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 2010-12-02 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-ngr-nl.
